bio: Clayton Hotel Cambridge is a luxurious and modern hotel located in the heart of the historic city, offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Enjoy the British tradition of Afternoon Tea in style, featuring a delectable assortment of sweet and savoury treats within the elegant surroundings of our hotel.  This luxurious and contemporary establishment is nestled in the heart of Cambridge, perfect for travellers seeking a memorable stay. With its prime location and modern amenities, the hotel stands as a prime choice for visitors.  The charming Library area within the hotel serves as the perfect setting for Afternoon Tea, offering an atmosphere that is both elegant and cozy. This distinctive space allows guests to relax and enjoy their tea in a serene environment, surrounded by the ambiance of classic literature and fine decor.  At Clayton Hotel Cambridge, a delightful and traditional Afternoon Tea menu is offered. The menu features a delectable array of freshly baked scones, dainty finger sandwiches, and a variety of pastries, all accompanied by a selection of teas and coffees.
